description: This file defines a ViewModel class for creating or updating notes within an Android application. It interacts with a notes repository to save and load note data, encapsulating business logic for note editing activities.

classes.name: NoteEditViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing note creation and updates, providing save and load functionalities, scoped to the application lifecycle.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note; creates a new note if id is 0, otherwise updates the existing note. Executes asynchronously within the ViewModel's scope.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Suspends and loads a note by its id, returning the note object or null if not found.
